name: a1-lane
description: Draft, schedule and publish social posts and videos from Grok Build, with a delivery receipt for every destination. Bundles the hosted A1 Lane MCP server (37 tools) with workflow skills. Works today with YouTube, X, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord and Telegram, plus Instagram professional accounts, Facebook Pages you manage, LinkedIn personal profiles and Threads profiles (limited). TikTok is coming once each platform approves our app. Also connects DEV (unofficial), Slack (limited), Tumblr and Pixelfed (limited) for posting from AI assistants and the API.
